- [ ] Entry generated by `tau-rec leaderboard make-entry` — not written by hand

- [ ] Simulator left at `gpt-5-mini` (or noted above, knowing those entries are
      ranked in a separate section)
- [ ] `model_id` is a pinned snapshot, or `"pinned": false` with an accurate
      `run_date`
- [ ] `uv run tau-rec leaderboard validate` passes
- [ ] `LEADERBOARD.md` committed from `tau-rec leaderboard render` — CI runs
      `render --check` and fails if it drifts
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
